blocks.text: Emerging technologies lagataar tarraqi kar rahi hain, aur future trends (aage aane wali tabdeeliyan) aur innovations (nayi cheezein aur naye tareeqe) cloud computing aur blockchain ki shakal badal rahi hain. Yeh hissa in fields ki kuch sab se promising (achhi umeed wali) advancements (tarraqi) dikhata hai aur batata hai ke yeh hamare technology ke ecosystem (poora system) ko kaise badal rahi hain.

blocks.prompt: Cloud ke do aur blockchain ke do future trends bataiye.
blocks.explanation: Cloud: edge computing aur serverless architectures. Blockchain: Blockchain 2.0 (smart contracts, dApps) aur AI aur IoT ke saath integration (mel).

items: Blockchain: Blockchain 2.0, AI aur IoT ke saath mel.
